title: May 16, 2022 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
SOUTH AUSTIN VMU COMMUNITY MEETING  
MONDAY, MAY 16, 2022, AT 6:30 PM 
 
REGISTER USING THE FOLLOWING LINK: 
https://forms.gle/pAiWbrv5fqHm3ipq7 
 
6:30 PM 
Attend a virtual information session regarding the Vertical Mixed Use program, 
Compatibility, and Project Connect along designated corridors in Council Districts 2, 3, 5, 
and 9. 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
